content: सुषुम्णः, -म्नः <ab>N.</ab> of one of the principal rays of the sun; <ls>Hch. 1</ls>. .{@-म्णा, -म्ना@} A particular artery of the human body, said to lie between इडा and पिङ्गला, two of the vessels of the body; वैश्वानरं याति विहायसा गतः सुषुम्नया ब्रह्मपथेन शोचिषा <ls>Bhāg. 2. 2. 24</ls>.
